original_question: Maka ụbọchị ọmụmụ 30th ya, Elvira họrọ kọmputa ọhụrụ nwere ọtụtụ ngwa dị ka onyinye. O nwere atumatu mmefu ego nke €1500 nke ezinụlọ ya niile nyere ya ma chee na ya ga-enwe ike idebe obere ego iji nwetanwu ákwà. Ọ gara ụlọ ahịa kọmputa wee họrọ igwe nke pụtara €1090 nke nwere screen, keyboard na mouse. O nwerekwarari scanner maka €157, ihe ọkụ CD ruru €74 yana ngwa nbipute maka €102. Ego ole ka o nwere fọdụrụ ya maka ákwà ya?
